categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes fuzz test utilities (FuzzedSock in src/test/fuzz/util/net.cpp) and harnesses across 14 fuzz targets with the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Fixes misleading mock behavior in FuzzedSock and enables fuzzing of previously unreached networking error paths. Previously, mock sockets shared descriptor values causing CConnman::SocketHandler() to merge entries and act on one peer with another's events, while Wait() failed to simulate realistic OS partial events or connection resets.
